notes.title: Patch 1.2.1
notes.notes:
A level selection menu has been added for the "labyrinth" game mode.
Fixed a collision bug that prevented collecting items in the "labyrinth" game mode.

notes.title: Update 1.2.0
notes.notes:
[h2]Adapted game experience [/h2]
Difficulty levels no longer exist, so you no longer have to settle for predefined options. From now on, you choose how you play. Configure your game experience in the title screen > options > game experience. 

[h2]Alternative layout for the murderer’s house[/h2]
It’s the same house you already know, but its layout is different. This alternative scenario is intended to give a new challenge to the player. Some of the changes are: 
[list]
[*] New corridors and changes in some rooms. 
[*] Fewer hiding places. 
[*] No save game (the instant camera starts empty). 
[/list]
This alternative scenario can be enabled from the title screen > options > game experience. [i]Recommended only for players who have already completed the game. [/i]

[h2]New game mode: labyrinth [/h2]
Your objective is to make the elevator work, to achieve it, you will have to explore a labyrinthine scenery in search of the necessary objects, all this while the murderer looks for you all over the place. This new game mode has two levels.

Now you can also get the soundtrack of the game!

notes.title: Patch 1.1.4
notes.notes:
[h2]Bugs Fixed[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the killer could see the player through one of the walls.
[*] Fixed a bug when getting the achievements.
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented to unlock the chapter “911 call”.
[/list]

[h2]Minor Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Now it’s easier to interact with the bonfire when using the bucket.
[*] The lighting of all the scenarios has been improved.
[*] It’s now possible to restart a chapter from the options menu.
[*] The game now asks for confirmation before returning to the Title Screen.
[*] The camera movement has been improved.
[/list]
